selection_importance.causal: router weight times calibration expected slab residual norm
selection_importance.static: calibration expected slab residual norm within each expert

whole_expert_expected_mean_tail.description: Complete experts ranked by router weight times calibration mean native output norm; omitted experts use their calibration mean.

uniform_static_slab_mean_tail.description: Every active expert receives the same slab count; per-expert slabs are ranked by calibration mean residual norm.

adaptive_expected_residual_slab_mean_tai.description: The global token budget is allocated by router weight times calibration mean slab residual norm.

heldout_residual_norm_slab_mean_tail.description: Diagnostic selection ranks the unknown held-out weighted slab residual norm; it is not a deployable oracle for direction.

warnings: Layer-one directional agreement is not final-logit quality.
Python dequantization and split reductions need not be bit-identical to the native quantized GPU kernel.
Physical progressive reads require an expert-slab sidecar or repacked bank; standard GGUF tensor layout is not the intended serving layout.
The held-out residual-norm ranking is diagnostic and is not an oracle for cosine-optimal subset selection.
The slab mean tail adds storage and memory traffic beyond the routed IQ1_S payload; its all-layer BF16 size is reported explicitly.
